description: Use this first when the user names a group, a person or an expense without its token. Searches every group the user belongs to by group name, member name, expense description or category, or by an exact amount ("7000", "¥7,000", "12.50") or ISO date ("2026-05-22"). A blank query returns the most recently active groups.

q.description:
Words from a group, member, expense or category name, an amount, or an
ISO date. Leave it out for the most recently active groups.
